title: Towa Powa (superset of Tricky Towers) Demo available Now !
author: monsieurlouistri

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/monsieurlouistri please share some more about the role AI played in developing this. Rule 4 is how we keep promotional posts contributing, by having them talk about the process and how the game was made. Without it, the sub would turn into a billboard. This post may be removed if it isn't updated.

replies.author: monsieurlouistri
replies.body: AI was involved in lots of aspect for the creation of the game, as a tool. The obvious things being localisation and code. More specifically, svg generators fine tuned, along with normal maps generators. And I think the area I used the most tokens on is the refining of bots, they are deterministic, but can adapt very well to lots of situations, plan depending on the mode rules, compute the best moves depending on topology, plan attacks,... I created lots of tools with the help of gpt and Claude (I really could feel the improvement in understanding of the LLMs models for hard subjects like the refining of my bots, especially these last 6 months). I'll post more in details about the tools created/used if people are interested.
